# Our song

The owner explicitly identified **The One I Choose** by **Devin Velez** as the couple's memorable song. This personal association comes from the owner; the book does not invent when or why they first heard it.

The title and artist are independently confirmed by the [official Apple Music release](https://music.apple.com/us/album/the-one-i-choose-single/6791815005), checked on 27 October 2026. That release is the listening destination used by the website. No guessed Spotify/YouTube identifier, downloaded recording, lyrics or cover art is added.

The published `memorableSong` record is separate from the retired favorite-artist song records. The printed paper keepsake leads with “Our song”, Devin Velez and The One I Choose. Its opened reader contains only that keepsake and the official listening link, without unrelated artist descriptions or a playlist. Favorite-artist portraits remain decorative scrapbook pieces.

Owner settings can edit the title, artist and HTTPS listening URL, and retain them in JSON export/import and browser-local saving. Existing saved data without this field receives the confirmed shared default while its earlier songs, artist notes and personal writing remain in backups. Retired fields are no longer displayed or overwritten by the editor. An intentionally blank title displays an honest shared-song placeholder, rather than bringing back another artist's song.

The official recording opens through the listening link. Existing instrumental ambient controls and the candle-controlled Happy Birthday melody retain their behavior; this update does not present the ambient music-box synthesis as Devin Velez's recording.
